preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of the string s must be an odd number between 1 and 49.
The string c must be a single lowercase letter.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if s == c else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if the string s can be reduced to the letter c, otherwise output 'NO'.
